page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-384 is a high-capacity instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is equipped with 3024.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 7.88 GB per vCPU. This configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-highmem-384 offers high resource density, consolidating massive compute and memory capacities into a single virtual machine. This consolidation reduces the overhead associated with managing multiple smaller instances. However, the lack of bundled local storage and complimentary public IPv4 addresses represents a tradeoff, requiring users to provision and budget for external storage and networking resources separately.

This server is designed for large-scale enterprise workloads that require substantial memory capacity and high-core parallel processing. Suitable workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, intensive enterprise resource planning systems, massive data analytics pipelines, and memory-bound scientific simulations.
